content.text:
The site's text had lost its bold weights, and I've fixed it. All 12 visual tests (6 pages at desktop and phone size) and all 16 functional tests now pass.

The `@font-face` rule in `site/css/tokens.css` declared the font as weight 400 only. Headings, nav links and buttons use weights 600 to 800, so the browser faked the bold by smearing the regular glyphs. I changed the declaration to `font-weight: 100 900;`, which lets the browser use the font's real weights, and nothing else changed.

I couldn't check whether the font file is a true variable font, because the tool I'd use to inspect it isn't installed. The restored screenshots match the approved ones, so the fix looks right in practice.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
